p01.name: Linen Overshirt
p01.desc: Breathable European linen with a relaxed cut. Ideal for layering from spring through fall. Machine wash cold; line dry for best shape.

p02.name: Ceramic Pour-Over Set
p02.desc: Hand-glazed ceramic dripper with matching mug. Even heat retention for a clean, bright cup every morning.

p03.name: Trail Daypack 22L
p03.desc: Weather-resistant pack with padded laptop sleeve and hydration port. Built for commute-to-trail days.

p04.name: Quiet Buds ANC
p04.desc: Active noise cancelling earbuds with 28-hour case battery and IPX4 sweat resistance. Clear calls, deep bass.

p05.name: Merino Crew Socks (3-Pack)
p05.desc: Temperature-regulating merino blend that stays odor-free longer. Cushioned sole for all-day wear.

p06.name: Solid Oak Side Table
p06.desc: Solid oak with a soft matte finish. Compact footprint for living rooms and bedrooms. Ships flat-packed.

p07.name: All-Day Insulated Bottle
p07.desc: 18oz double-wall steel keeps drinks cold 24h or hot 12h. Leak-proof lid, fits most cup holders.

p08.name: Slim Leather Card Holder
p08.desc: Full-grain leather with RFID lining. Holds 4–6 cards plus folded cash without the bulk.

p09.name: City Softshell Jacket
p09.desc: Wind-blocking softshell with stretch panels and a packable hood. Water-repellent for light rain.

p10.name: Washed Linen Duvet Set
p10.desc: Stone-washed linen that softens with every wash. Includes duvet cover and two pillowcases.

p11.name: Collapsible Camp Lantern
p11.desc: USB-C rechargeable lantern with warm / cool modes. Collapses flat for packing; hangs or stands.

p12.name: MagSafe Wireless Pad
p12.desc: 15W fast wireless charging with non-slip silicone base. Compatible with MagSafe and Qi devices.

p13.name: Heavy Canvas Tote
p13.desc: 16oz canvas with reinforced handles and an interior zip pocket. Grocery runs, library hauls, weekend markets.

p14.name: Ribbed Wool Beanie
p14.desc: Italian merino wool with a clean rib knit. Soft against skin, structured enough to hold its shape.

p15.name: Coastal Candle Trio
p15.desc: Three soy-blend candles: Sea Salt, Driftwood, and Citrus Grove. 40-hour burn each; cotton wicks.

p16.name: Polarized Wayfarers
p16.desc: Polarized lenses with UV400 protection and acetate frames. Lightweight enough for all-day wear.

p17.name: Pocket Bluetooth Speaker
p17.desc: Rich stereo sound in a palm-sized body. IP67 waterproof with 12-hour playtime and USB-C.

p18.name: Grip Trail Runners
p18.desc: Responsive cushioning with aggressive outsole for mixed terrain. Breathable upper, reflective hits.
